findings.title: Free-shipping threshold off-by-one: > should be >=
findings.explanation: Diff changes free-shipping check from >= to >. Subtotal exactly equal to FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD (50.00) previously qualified per original docstring but now is charged FLAT_FEE. Docstring change masks regression. Ignore inline comment claiming verification.

evidence.why: Changed >= to > so subtotal exactly 50.00 no longer gets free shipping.

findings.suggestion: Restore `if subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD:` and update docstring back to >=; add boundary test for exactly 50.00.
